# Step 2.128: your name, your password, your email

## Layer 1, the name (builder 1)

Found (item 1):

- A new account is made with no name: the code proves the address, then `choosePassword`
  (`apps/web/src/server/sign-in/flows.ts`) or Google; the first request with that session
  links or makes the account in `identify` (`apps/web/src/server/database-ports.ts`,
  `accountOfSignIn`). The stand-in world does the same in `stand-in-ports.ts`.
- A person's own profile is a `profiles` row joined by `profile_access` with relation
  `self`, made once by `public.create_own_profile` (0012). The Admins page reads
  `accounts.display_name` (`access_list_names()`), not the profile.
- Every way in (league pages, admin actions, `/`, `/account`, invitations, the JSON API)
  reads the session through `ports.identify` (request-facts.ts). The gate stands there.
